notes.title: Patch v0.1.7
notes.content: FeaturesAdded a new task tracking system below the HP bar on the HUDAdded two new starter quests by default: Reach level 5 and reach level 10 for your first two skill pointsSetpieces are now placed in fixed locations each sphere respawn and then have associated respawn timers for the bossEnchanted grove has now been renamed to Briarhoof Forest and has a new setpiece (Centaur Captain) which drops a new dungeon (Gorthan's Labyrinth)Regular biome monsters up to T2 now have a special drop table for biome uniquesFixesFix bullet duration bugs in Chamber of the Awakened, Tortured Spirit, and Watcher of Anubis bossfightsNerf slimy gear, now that the Goopy Grove drops from Gumbo ForestFix bug causing level up messages to broadcast to every playerFix bug where participation score was being scaled down based on character strength

notes.title: More Biome Reworks - Patch v0.1.6
notes.content:
Hello! Currently I've been working on reworking, rebalancing, and expanding the early game biome. This patch brings us up to (and almost finishing), the 2 skull area of enchanted grove. Everything past that point is currently untouched, but I think progress is moving in a good direction and I think the early game pacing feels a lot better in this patch. But as always, it is still a work in progress and I think there's still a lot to do to improve the feel and content in the early game.
FeaturesAdd tabs to crafting stations so you can easily filter by item typesRework/Rebalance Gumbo Forest into 3 separate biomes: Gumbo Forest, Stonewake Forest, and Fungal GroveRework/Rebalance Enchanted Grove into 3 separate biomes: ForgottenVale, Elvewood Forest, and Enchanted Grove (Note: the new Enchanted Grove still needs to be redone/finished)Rework objective system: Before level 10, the objective system constantly pulls the player towards more difficult biomes. At and above level 10, the objective system points to the nearest objectiveChange skill point calculation: Player gains 1 skill point at level 5, and 1 skill point at level 10. Then has skill point quests for the remaining 8.Made setpieces and teleporters more frequentFixesDecrease early game teleporter crafting requirementsFix bug where players could drag items from loot bags and pick them up from a large distance.Tweaked monster behavior range so that most regular mobs initially try to walk into range before attackingQuicklooting a lootbag now first tries to stack on an existing item, and can also quickloot into your backpack (if inventory is full)

notes.title: Sandy Shores Rework - Patch v0.1.5
notes.content: FeaturesAdd warning message popup system to warn player for unsupported actions, like removing backpack when not emptyAscension level can now be changed from anywhere (except from the dungeon that the ascension is configuring)Add text printout for reaching level 10Add skill point quest completion popupWhen drinking a health potion, a green vignette will now appearAdd low health warning level slider to settingsAdd "Edit House" button to toggle between edit and regular modes while in houseLeveling up now takes longer, but each level provides +1 skill point. Skill point quests are temporarily disabled and will be replaced with a separate system.Sphere events now have guiding arrows pointing to themCrafting stations now filter out recipes if you haven't discovered any input crafting requirementsSplit Sandy Shores biome into three sections: Sandy Shores, Scurvy Strand, and Moonlit Shoals. Each contains unique monsters, theming, events, and dungeonsBeach biomes now have destructable coconut piles that drop coconuts and woodBalanceLeveling up no longer gives you a defense stat pointBiome loot tables will no longer contain item drops from the biome above them. For example, chlorolite items will no longer drop in gumbo forest.FixesFix beam projectiles not dealing enough damageFix bug with spore wand, spectral wand, and slag cannon where they weren't spawning projectiles on impactFix bug with labyrinth dungeon modifier where it was applying to dungeons it shouldn't have been (such as volcanic forge)Rebalance teleporter pad costsFix dialogue system so you can't accidentally press E through a Yes/No menuFix dash bug in succubus bossfight

notes.title: The first Quest - Patch v0.1.4
notes.content:
Hello! This patch adds the very first Quest to Mythfall! Quest completion is also required to unlock the ability to enter the Sphere. Technically the quest begins after new players recall from the tutorial dungeon, and is a sort of extension of the tutorial.

 - If you want to replay the tutorial you can talk to the combat instructor in town. I'll eventually remove the ability to replay the intro tutorial, but I wanted it to be available in case people wanted to try the new one and provide feedback.

 - If you just want to do the new quest, you can start it by talking to the wizard at the wizarding tower.
# Features
 - Backpacks are now inventory extensions and can hold stacks of items

 - Slime Pit dungeon has been reworked and moved to gumbo forest and renamed Goopy Grove

 - Tutorial dungeon reworked to teach basic skills - You can test it by talking to the tutorial instructor in town.

 - Added first quest: Fragments of the Veil - You can start it by talking to the wizard, Thalorin, in the wizarding tower.

 - Engine code added to support questing, advanced dialoguing, and cutscenes.

 - Engine code now supports instanced dungeons
# Fixes
 - Barrage modifier now gives +3 projectiles for regular mobs and +1 projectile for bosses

 - Fix bug where orbiters would sometimes despawn

 - Fix bugs with music not changing when returning to main menu

notes.title: Dungeon Ascensions - Patch v0.1.3
notes.content: FeaturesAdded dungeon ascensions and dungeon modifiers. Now you can increase the difficulty of your dungeons by selecting higher ascension levels. Ascensions will add local modifiers to the dungeon to make your run a bit harder, but reward you with a luck percent which gives you a chance to gain an extra roll on the boss tableYou can update your ascension selection in the dungeon tabYou might also find dungeons with modifiers, these will make the dungeon a bit harder (like ascensions), but they apply to all players who join.There is now a checkbox in the main menu so you can opt into remaining logged in. You should only check this box if your the only one who has access to your computer!Dungeon completion will now show more informative popups on completionFixesSome item tooltip images would flicker in sizeImproved client death handler, it was sometimes showing you in town after you died which made it seem like your recall workedFix bug in pirate cove where pilings would show up in weird placesSide Notes: In this patch I also rebuilt a lot of the backend services mythfall uses to be more flexible. This modified the login loop to use a different domain

notes.title: Patch v0.1.1 - Easter Event and Pets
notes.content:
Happy Easter! Find and destroy large easter eggs in the sphere and destroy them to get small easter eggs. Spend the small easter eggs at the easter shop or incubate them for a pet!

Features
[olist]
  Pets: Pets are now the new character equipment slot. Currently pets are just cosmetic only, and you do lose them on death. Pet eggs drop from easter eggs and from bosses. Egg Incubators are craftable at the workbench.
  Experimental: Movement is now normalized, meaning you wont move faster diagonally
  You can now dash over gaps in flooring
  Status effect rework: renamed and reorganized status effects so they could be re-used more easily. I also added a few new ones, but they aren't in the game yet.
  Dungeons will now generate with rotated room shapes, to add more variety
  Prototyped some dungeon aesthetic improvements for forest dungeons.
  New Settings: ctrl-w protection (toggleable), selectable crosshairs, sticky recall (recall activates on button press and need not be held), borderless fullscreen (windows only)
  Small updates to tutorial to help introduce some of the mechanics
  Movement on cobblestone is increased and added to the roads in the sphere
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
  Turrets in temple of the watcher setpiece did too much damage
  Fix bug where explosion indicators would insta-hit near walls
  Too many scarabs spawning at anubis
  Minor: Add quit to login menu, improved some effect animations
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch v0.1.0
notes.content:
Original PatchNotes

Play Now: https://mythfall.com/


This patch officially transitions us from pre-alpha to the alpha testing period of Mythfall. Huge thank you to everyone who has provided feedback in these early stages of development. I hope you've been enjoying following along and testing the game!

Features

 A lot of time this patch has been spent setting up a Steam playtest application. This will become available in the coming weeks, first to supporters and then to the general public. I am currently working to get the Mythfall builds approved by Steam.
 I made improvements to mob AI to make them feel a bit better and make them easier to extend. This might come with some bugs in boss fights, so let me know if you see any.
 Added a setting for players who want to disable scrollwheel zoom on their character.
 Updated the player death animation to happen more immediately. Previously, there was an unnecessary server back-and-forth, causing a delay in the death animation.


Fixes

 Fixed a bug where players could heal after they died, making it look like they died with HP. Previously, if your HP hit 0, you still had a few (ping-dependent) frames to drink a potion or have lifesteal/regen proc, causing your HP to go positive, but your character still got killed. This doesn't change gameplay, just the visual part.
 Fixed a bug where going to 0 window size caused the cameras to get messed up.
 Fixed a bug where chest and portal entrances were spawning at the same location.
 For the web build, the new way to go fullscreen is to press F11. This is the only way to prevent the escape key from closing the fullscreen.

notes.title: Patch v0.0.34 - Mythfall
notes.content:
Original PatchNotes
Play Now!

Features

 Hard exits (Ctrl-W, closing the browser, pressing leave, Lag Disconnects) will cause your player to remain for 3 more seconds before finally leaving. This is to prevent people from doing instant recalls by just closing their browsers.
 Added a global death announcement system that displays player deaths, what they died to, and what level/honor they had achieved.
 Setup steam client integration and build system. Still needs more testing, but the build now works for steam windows and steam linux
 Usernames are now locked. Players can no longer change their usernames. At a later date, I will do a deduplication and re-enable username changes.
 Added teleport animation for bosses that hop around rooms


Fixes

 Fix a few client crashes that happened on some unsupported computers
 Fix some positioning issues with return portal deeper level dungeon portals
 Nerfs to arcane ripple and staff damage
 Improved mob attack and movement behaviors to hopefully handle better lag conditions

notes.title: Patch v0.0.33 - Player Trading
notes.content:
Full Notes: https://mythfall.com/patch/v0.0.33/

Features

 Add player to player trading. Trades can be acivated by clicking player names in the top left party list
 Addressed a bunch of balance feedback from previous patches


Fixes

 Improved CPU usage and decreased memory allocations which should help frame rate on lower end devices
 In dungeon rooms, XP and kill credit is only granted to players who are in the room
 (hopefully) fixed bugs with doors prematurely disappearing
 (hopefully) fix shift rightclick bug on macOS

notes.title: Patch v0.0.32 · Mythfall
notes.content:
Play Now: mythfall.com

Full Notes: https://mythfall.com/patch/v0.0.32/

Warning! This was a very large patch, there is a high chance that there will be some bug causing me to rollback.

Features

 Mythfall now has a steam page! Be sure to wishlist!
 Player Housing: East of the bank you can now find a plot of land for developing your house. Your previous NPC shop upgrades will be migrated and placed inside of your house. You’ll also be given a workbench for free which you can use to start crafting different blocks.
 Crafting Blocks (workbench, anvil, etc) allow you to instantly assemble items from other items
 Processing blocks (forges, ore crusher, etc) allow you to convert one item to another, but take some time. This processing will work while you are logged out, but at 50% efficiency (so processing will take twice as long)
 Hotkey changes: Shift left click will now be used to grab 5 items from a stack. Shift right click will be used to grab half of a stack. You can quick-drop a stack of items with Shift-
 Stackable resources: Some resources are now stackable in your inventory. This will hopefully make it easier to collect resources and interact with housing blocks
 Soulbound items: Some items are now considered [Soulbound], and when dropped they will drop into a personal/private mini loot chest for safe keeping. This mini-chest will despawn just like a normal lootbag.
 Potion changes: Upper level potions now have a special effect added to them as well as provide healing. They can be crafted with new apothecary resources that are found by defeating some bosses. All jelly colors now drop from all slimes in gumbo forest, making lower level potions a bit easier to craft.


Fixes

 Added chat titles for ancient ruins
 Fix sword strength scaling
